current_observable.question: Is the canonical worktree clean at the end of R7 acceptance, with generated evidence separated from source state and all remaining product limitations and falsifiers recorded exactly without overstating readiness?

observable_15_falsifiers: generated validation artifacts are staged or tracked as product source without explicit acceptance
remaining product limitations or known falsifiers are omitted or materially understated
release or publish readiness is claimed before separate release/package readiness acceptance
implementation or architecture changes are enabled during final acceptance closure

known_harness_classifications.detail: The first repaired Observable 13 completion assertion compared CompletionDecision.satisfied_requirement_ids with contract evidence_kind values. Canonical completion evaluation returns requirement_id values by design. Runtime behavior was correct; only the probe assertion was corrected.

The first Observable 14 command invoked scripts/check-implementation-gate.py while implementation was locked and no documentation paths were staged. That checker is a commit/staging gate, not a read-only runtime validator. The corrected Observable 14 proof did not invoke it and passed without source changes.
